description:
List the user's saved credentials (Global Integrations).

Saved credentials are referenced by ID when creating projects:
bot_token_integration_id for bot tokens, global_integration_ids for
other keys. Secret values are never returned — only IDs and metadata
(type, key name, verified, title). New credentials are added at
dreamagent.cloud → Settings → Global Integrations.
name: dreamagent_list_global_integrations
title: List connected integrations
